title: Methoxy Substitution and Alkyl Ligand Chain-Length Effects on DNA/BSA Binding and Anticancer Activity of Cobalt(III) Schiff Base Complexes
authors: Ambika Subramanian; Manojkumar Yesaiyan; Margrate Thatcher Robert; Rohith Ramasamy; Vijay Solomon Rajadurai; Gowdhami Balakrishnan; Arunachalam Sankaralingam
one_liner_zh: 该文研究钴(III)席夫碱配合物与DNA/BSA的结合及抗癌活性，虽涉及DNA结合和分子对接，但对象为小分子金属配合物而非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，方法以实验为主、DFT和对接为辅，与TF-DNA结合机制建模课题关联较弱。
abstract: A series of cobalt(III) salophen-type Schiff base complexes bearing methoxy substituents at the 3-, 4-, and 5-positions of the ligand, along with linear-chain alkyl amines of varying lengths (heptylamine vs. dodecylamine), were synthesized and characterized. DNA binding constants (Kb) ranged from 2.290 × 104 M⁻¹ (complex 1) to 4.628 × 104 M⁻¹ (complex 6), as determined by viscosity and ethidium bromide displacement studies, supporting a mixed groove–intercalative binding mode. Bovine serum albumin (BSA) fluorescence quenching experiments yielded binding constants up to 5.102 × 106 M⁻¹ (complex 5), with positive entropy changes indicating a significant hydrophobic contribution. DFT calculations were performed to probe the electronic structures of these metal complexes. Molecular docking analyses revealed stabilizing interactions of the 5-methoxy substituent with nucleobases and preferential positioning near Trp-212 in BSA. In A549 lung carcinoma cells, the 5-methoxy dodecylamine complex (complex 6) exhibited the highest cytotoxicity (IC50 = 32 μM), surpassing the unsubstituted analogue (65 μM) and comparable to cisplatin (30 μM) under identical conditions. Importantly, cell-cycle analysis revealed a structure-dependent bifurcation: complexes 1, 3, and 5 predominantly induced Sub-G₀/G₁ populations, whereas complexes 2, 4, and 6 promoted G₂/M arrest. These findings establish a coherent structure–activity relationship (SAR) in which methoxy position and axial-ligand hydrophobicity govern biomolecular interactions and translate into distinct cellular outcomes, providing design principles for future cobalt(III) complex-based anticancer agents.
abstract_zh: 合成并表征了一系列在配体3、4、5位带有甲氧基取代基的钴(III) salophen型席夫碱配合物，以及不同链长的直链烷基胺（庚胺与十二胺）。通过粘度法和溴化乙锭置换实验测定的DNA结合常数（Kb）范围为2.290 × 10⁴ M⁻¹（配合物1）至4.628 × 10⁴ M⁻¹（配合物6），支持混合沟槽-嵌入结合模式。牛血清白蛋白（BSA）荧光猝灭实验得到的结合常数高达5.102 × 10⁶ M⁻¹（配合物5），正熵变表明存在显著的疏水贡献。进行了DFT计算以探究这些金属配合物的电子结构。分子对接分析揭示了5-甲氧基取代基与核碱基的稳定相互作用，以及在BSA中优先定位于Trp-212附近。在A549肺癌细胞中，5-甲氧基十二胺配合物（配合物6）表现出最高的细胞毒性（IC50 = 32 μM），优于未取代类似物（65 μM），并在相同条件下与顺铂（30 μM）相当。重要的是，细胞周期分析揭示了结构依赖性分叉：配合物1、3和5主要诱导Sub-G₀/G₁群体，而配合物2、4和6促进G₂/M期阻滞。这些发现建立了连贯的构效关系（SAR），其中甲氧基位置和轴向配体疏水性控制生物分子相互作用并转化为不同的细胞结果，为未来基于钴(III)配合物的抗癌药物提供了设计原则。
